elements.description: The right end of an app header: the page's bell and app picker, and the person's avatar with their account card.

properties.name: accountItems
properties.description: The account card's actions; unset shows Settings, Language, Docs and Sign out

properties.name: setup
properties.description: Profile setup progress in the account card – unset hides it

properties.name: accountLabel
properties.description: The account popover's name, and the start of the avatar's ("Account")

properties.name: panel
properties.description: The open popover, or null for none

properties.name: separator
properties.description: The hairline before the avatar (default true; separator="false" hides it)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-panel-change
events.description: A popover is opening or closing ({ panel }: HeaderNavPanelChange, null when none); cancelable – prevented, `panel` stays as it is (controlled use)

events.name: tc-account-select
events.description: An account action was picked ({ id }: HeaderNavAccountSelect); cancelable – prevented, the card stays open

events.name: tc-setup-continue
events.description: The setup's next step was picked in the account card ({ next }: HeaderNavSetupContinue); cancelable – prevented, the card stays open

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The page's <tc-notifications> and <tc-app-picker>, in that order

functions.name: headerNavInitials
functions.description: One or two initials from a name: "Ada Lovelace" → "AL"

functions.name: headerNavTone
functions.description: The tone a name gets when the user has none – the same every time

functions.name: headerNavDefaultItems
functions.description: The account card's actions when `accountItems` is unset: Settings, Language, Docs and Sign out

props.name: notifications
props.description: The bell: <Notifications> props – the app's items and handlers. Unset hides the bell

props.name: apps
props.description: The app picker: <AppPicker> props – the app's apps, pins and handlers. Unset hides the picker

props.name: accountItems
props.description: The account card's actions; unset shows Settings, Language, Docs and Sign out. Icons may be React nodes

props.name: onAccountSelect
props.description: An account action was picked (the popover closes and focus returns to the avatar)

props.name: setup
props.description: Profile setup progress in the account card – unset hides it

props.name: onSetupContinue
props.description: The setup's next step was picked

props.name: open
props.description: The open popover (controlled), null for none

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The popover open at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: A popover opened (its name) or closed (null)

changelog: All 18 blocks are now elements – `tc-agent-gallery`, `tc-ai-side-pane`, `tc-ai-workspace`, `tc-app-directory`, `tc-client-context`, `tc-evidence-gallery`, `tc-header-nav`, `tc-invoice-credit`, `tc-kpi-board`, `tc-logo-marquee`, `tc-metrics-dashboard`, `tc-oversight-home`, `tc-pricing-plans`, `tc-publish-readiness`, `tc-red-team-finding`, `tc-task-board`, `tc-testimonial-wall`, `tc-uncertainty-mix` – so Angular (`trenchcoat/angular`), Vue, Svelte, plain HTML and generative UI get them like any component, with docs pages.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
